name: RAG Pipelines
certifications: No single vendor certification; assessed by capstone project
Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate

beginner.summary: For Python developers new to retrieval-augmented generation. Covers why RAG is needed, loading and chunking documents, embeddings, vector stores, retrieval, prompting with context, citations and basic evaluation, ending with a working document question-answering assistant.
prerequisites: Writes basic Python and uses pip and virtual environments
Has called an LLM API or is ready to use a local Ollama model
outcomes: Explain how RAG grounds model answers in documents
Build a RAG pipeline from loading to answering with citations
Choose chunking, embeddings and vector stores for a use case
Measure retrieval and answer quality on a test set

days.topic: RAG Overview, Use Cases and Environment Setup
subtopics: RAG versus fine-tuning versus long context
The pipeline: ingest, index, retrieve, generate
Typical use cases: policies, support, research
Installing Python packages for the course
API keys or a local Ollama model
days.lab_task: Ask a model 10 questions about the sample company handbook with and without the handbook pasted in, record the accuracy of both and list the problems that pasting the whole handbook causes.
days.deliverable: Accuracy table for both approaches and a problem list
checks: Answer the 10 questions without the handbook
Wrong or made-up answers are marked
Answer them with the handbook pasted in
Paste a handbook larger than the context window
Participant explains the error and why retrieval is needed

days.topic: Loading Documents: PDFs, Word Files, Web Pages and Databases
days.lab_task: Load the sample collection of PDFs, Word files, web pages and a database table into one list of documents with source and page metadata, and report extraction problems.
days.deliverable: Loader script, document count by type and extraction problem report
checks: Open a document from a PDF
Has the source file and page number
Text is extracted by OCR or the file is reported as needing OCR

days.topic: Chunking Strategies
days.lab_task: Chunk the handbook three ways (fixed size, by paragraph and by heading), inspect 20 chunks of each, and pick the method that keeps answers to five test questions inside single chunks.
days.deliverable: Three chunk sets, inspection notes and the chosen method
checks: Find the answer to each test question
Chosen method keeps each answer in one chunk
Look at a chunk containing a table
Counts and average sizes recorded for all three methods

days.topic: Embeddings: Turning Text into Vectors
days.lab_task: Embed the handbook chunks with a hosted and an open embedding model, run ten queries with each and compare which model ranks the correct chunk first more often.
days.deliverable: Embedding script and a comparison of the two models
checks: Run the ten queries with both models
Top-1 hit rate recorded for each
Query in Hindi against English chunks with a multilingual model

days.topic: Vector Stores and Indexing
days.lab_task: Store the handbook chunks in Chroma and in Qdrant, filter searches by department metadata, update one document and delete another, and reload the index after a restart.
days.deliverable: Index scripts and search results with filters
checks: Update a document and search again
New text is returned and the old text is gone

days.topic: Retrieval: Top-k Search and Similarity Thresholds
subtopics: Retrieval for short and long questions
days.lab_task: Tune k, a similarity threshold and maximal marginal relevance for the handbook retriever on 20 test questions, and log every retrieval for review.
days.deliverable: Retriever settings, test results and retrieval log
checks: Measure hit rate at k = 3 and k = 8
Both recorded with the chosen setting justified

days.topic: Prompting with Retrieved Context
subtopics: Instructions to use only the context
days.lab_task: Write a RAG prompt template that answers only from the retrieved context, says when the answer is missing and fits within a token budget, and test it on 20 questions.
days.deliverable: Prompt template and test results
checks: Ask a question whose answer is not in the context
Model says it cannot find the answer
Count tokens for the largest prompt

days.topic: Your First RAG Pipeline End to End
subtopics: Connecting loader, chunker, embedder and store
Code structure for a RAG project
days.lab_task: Build a complete RAG command-line tool over the handbook with sources in every answer, settings in one configuration file and timing for each stage.
days.deliverable: RAG project, configuration file and timing output
checks: Every answer lists its source documents and pages
Change the chunk size in configuration
Pipeline re-indexes with the new size and no code change
Retrieval and generation times are shown
objectives: Build a RAG pipeline end to end

days.topic: Citations and Source Attribution
subtopics: Mapping citations to documents and pages
days.lab_task: Make the assistant cite chunk IDs inline, convert them to document and page links, quote the supporting sentence and automatically check that each quote appears in the cited chunk.
days.deliverable: Citation code, sample answers and the citation check report
checks: Run the citation checker on 20 answers
Every quote is found in its cited chunk
Ask about a topic with two conflicting documents
Answer mentions both and the newer date
Click a source link in the UI

days.topic: Hybrid Search: Keywords and Vectors Together
subtopics: Hybrid search in Qdrant or Elasticsearch
days.lab_task: Add BM25 keyword search to the retriever, combine it with vector search using reciprocal rank fusion and measure the gain on questions that mention policy numbers and product codes.
days.deliverable: Hybrid retriever and before and after results
checks: Hybrid finds it where vector search alone does not
Hybrid scores higher than vector only

days.topic: Reranking Retrieved Results
subtopics: Why the first retrieval is rough
days.lab_task: Retrieve 30 chunks and rerank to 5 with a cross-encoder and a hosted reranker, then compare answer accuracy and latency with no reranking.
days.deliverable: Reranking code and a comparison of accuracy and latency
checks: Choice balances accuracy and latency with numbers

days.topic: Query Transformation: Rewriting, Expansion and Decomposition
days.lab_task: Add query rewriting for follow-up questions, HyDE for vague questions and decomposition for multi-part questions, and measure each one's effect on 30 test questions.
days.deliverable: Query transformation code and measured effects
checks: Ask a follow-up like "and for contractors?"
Rewritten into a full question and answered correctly
Both parts are retrieved and answered
Compare accuracy with and without each method

days.topic: Evaluating RAG: Retrieval and Answer Quality
subtopics: Building a test set of questions and answers
Retrieval metrics: hit rate, recall and MRR
days.lab_task: Build a 40-question test set for the handbook, compute retrieval and answer metrics with Ragas for two pipeline versions and decide which to keep.
days.deliverable: Test set, metric results and a decision note
checks: Reported for both versions with low-scoring answers listed

days.topic: Conversational RAG with Chat History
days.lab_task: Build a Streamlit chat over the handbook that rewrites follow-up questions using history, streams answers with sources and passes a ten-turn scripted conversation test.
days.deliverable: Chat application and multi-turn test results
checks: Every turn answered correctly with sources
Reset the conversation and ask a follow-up
Assistant asks what the user means
Text streams as it is generated

days.topic: Structured and Tabular Data in RAG
subtopics: Combining SQL answers with document answers
days.lab_task: Add a text-to-SQL tool over a leave-balance table to the handbook assistant, route each question to documents or SQL and verify ten numeric answers against direct queries.
days.deliverable: Router, SQL tool and verification results
checks: Ask "how many leave days does employee 1042 have left?"
Answered from documents with a citation
objectives: Use tables and databases in RAG
Route questions to the right source

days.topic: Keeping the Index Fresh: Updates, Deletes and Versions
days.lab_task: Build a scheduled ingestion job that re-indexes only changed handbook files, removes deleted ones, keeps the latest version by effective date and reports index freshness.
days.deliverable: Ingestion job, run logs and freshness report
checks: Change one file and run the job
Delete a file and run the job
Its chunks are gone from the index

days.topic: Access Control and Security in RAG
days.lab_task: Add document permissions to the index, filter every search by the user's groups, mask personal data in answers and test for permission leaks and injected instructions.
days.deliverable: Permission filter, masking and security test results
checks: Ask as a normal employee about a manager-only document
Document is not retrieved or mentioned
Search with a document containing a hidden instruction
Ask for a colleague's phone number

days.topic: Debugging RAG: Finding Why an Answer Went Wrong
subtopics: Separating retrieval failures from generation failures
Checking whether the answer was in the index
Chunks that cut the answer in half
Prompts that let the model ignore context
days.lab_task: Diagnose ten wrong answers from the handbook assistant, label each as a loading, chunking, retrieval or prompt problem, fix them and add each case to the test set.
days.deliverable: Debugging log with cause, fix and new test case for each answer
checks: Each has a cause backed by the retrieval log
Rerun the ten questions after the fixes
At least eight are now correct
objectives: Debug RAG answers step by step
Tell retrieval and generation problems apart

days.topic: Deploying a RAG Service as an API
subtopics: FastAPI endpoints for ask and ingest
days.lab_task: Package the handbook assistant as a FastAPI service with ask and ingest endpoints, streaming, API keys and health checks in Docker, then load-test it with 20 users.
days.deliverable: Service code, Docker image and load test report
checks: Call the ask endpoint with curl
Error rate and p95 latency recorded

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Company Knowledge Assistant
days.lab_task: Build a knowledge assistant over a mixed document collection with hybrid retrieval, reranking, citations, permission filtering, scheduled re-indexing and a Ragas evaluation, deployed as an API with a chat UI, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Repository, evaluation report, API and a 10-minute demo
checks: Meets the agreed accuracy and faithfulness targets
Ask as a user without access to a document
Answer reflects the change after the next ingestion run
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one assistant

intermediate.summary: For developers who have built a basic RAG pipeline. Covers advanced ingestion, chunking and indexing, retrieval tuning, multi-index and multimodal RAG, graph and agentic retrieval, evaluation pipelines, observability, cost and scaling RAG in production.
prerequisites: Has built a RAG pipeline with a vector store
Writes Python confidently and uses Docker
Knows the basics of retrieval evaluation
outcomes: Design production RAG systems for large, changing document collections
Tune retrieval with hybrid search, reranking and query planning
Build multimodal, graph and agentic RAG
Evaluate, monitor and scale RAG services

days.topic: RAG Architecture for Production Systems
days.lab_task: Design the architecture for a 500,000-document RAG system with separate ingestion and query services, write two architecture decision records and build the skeleton services.
days.deliverable: Architecture diagram, two decision records and service skeletons
checks: Ingestion and query paths are separate with every store labelled
Options, trade-offs and decisions are written
Both start and pass health checks

days.topic: Advanced Document Parsing and Layout-Aware Ingestion
subtopics: Unstructured, Docling and cloud document AI
Choosing a parser per document type
days.lab_task: Parse a set of complex financial reports with three parsers, measure table and text accuracy against a hand-made reference and choose a parser per document type.
days.deliverable: Parsing outputs, accuracy comparison and parser choice
checks: Compare table extraction with the reference
Reading order is correct with the chosen parser
Choice per document type backed by the numbers

days.topic: Semantic and Hierarchical Chunking
days.lab_task: Compare fixed, semantic, hierarchical small-to-big and contextual-header chunking on the financial reports with a 50-question test set and choose a strategy.
days.deliverable: Chunking implementations and an evaluation table
checks: Run the 50 questions for each strategy
Hit rate and answer accuracy recorded
Small chunk matched and its parent section returned
Each chunk carries its document and section title

days.topic: Embedding Model Selection and Fine-Tuning
subtopics: Comparing embedding models on your data
Binary and scalar quantisation of vectors
days.lab_task: Fine-tune an open embedding model on generated question-chunk pairs from the financial reports, compare it with two stock models, and test smaller and quantised vectors for storage savings.
days.deliverable: Fine-tuned model, comparison and storage results
checks: Fine-tuned model is best or the reason is explained
Halve the vector size with Matryoshka

days.topic: Vector Database Operations at Scale
days.lab_task: Load 5 million vectors into Qdrant with sharding and payload indexes, tune HNSW for a recall and latency target, and restore a collection from a snapshot.
days.deliverable: Cluster configuration, tuning results and restore record
checks: Measure recall and p95 latency for three HNSW settings
Setting that meets both targets chosen
Filtered search stays fast with the payload index
Collection searchable with the same results

days.topic: Advanced Hybrid Retrieval and Learned Sparse Models
subtopics: Retrieval for code, IDs and numbers
days.lab_task: Add learned sparse vectors to hybrid retrieval, tune field boosts and run an ablation study to show the contribution of each component on the 50-question test set.
days.deliverable: Retriever configuration and ablation results
checks: Contribution of dense, sparse and keyword parts recorded
Search for an exact account code
Compare with the beginner hybrid setup

days.topic: Reranking, Filtering and Context Compression
days.lab_task: Build a multi-stage retriever that retrieves 100, reranks to 10, removes duplicates and compresses context, and show token savings and accuracy against the earlier pipeline.
days.deliverable: Multi-stage retriever and comparison results
checks: Place the key chunk in the middle and at the start

days.topic: Query Planning, Routing and Multi-Index RAG
days.lab_task: Build a router across HR, finance and IT indexes that extracts filters such as year and region from the question, plans sub-questions for comparisons and measures routing accuracy.
days.deliverable: Router and planner code with routing accuracy results
checks: Ask "compare 2024 and 2025 travel policy for India"
Two sub-questions with year and region filters
Router falls back and says the source is unavailable

days.topic: Multimodal RAG: Images, Tables, Charts and Slides
days.lab_task: Index product manuals with diagrams and slide decks, retrieve the right diagram for 15 questions and answer questions about charts using a vision model.
days.deliverable: Multimodal index and evaluation on 15 questions
checks: Ask about a part shown only in a diagram
Ask for a value from a chart
Correct value or a stated uncertainty

days.topic: GraphRAG and Knowledge Graph Retrieval
subtopics: When GraphRAG is worth the cost
days.lab_task: Build a knowledge graph from supplier contracts, answer 20 multi-hop and summary questions with GraphRAG and with vector RAG, and compare accuracy and cost.
days.deliverable: Graph, two pipelines and a comparison report
checks: Ask a global question about all suppliers

days.topic: Agentic RAG and Corrective Retrieval
subtopics: Agents that decide when and where to search
Corrective RAG when evidence is weak
days.lab_task: Build a LangGraph research agent that grades retrieved evidence, searches again or falls back to approved web sources when evidence is weak and stops within a step budget.
days.deliverable: Agent code and comparison with the plain pipeline
checks: Ask a question with weak first results
Agent grades the evidence as weak and searches again
Compare accuracy and cost with the plain pipeline on 30 questions
Agent stops within the step budget and says it cannot answer

days.topic: Long-Context Models versus Retrieval
days.lab_task: Answer the same 30 questions by sending whole documents to a long-context model, by RAG and by a combined approach with prompt caching, and compare accuracy, cost and latency.
days.deliverable: Three implementations and a comparison report
checks: Measure cost per question with and without caching
objectives: Choose an approach per use case

days.topic: Evaluation Pipelines and Test Set Management
days.lab_task: Generate a synthetic test set, review and fix it by hand, add component and end-to-end metrics to CI and block pull requests that lower faithfulness or recall.
days.deliverable: Test set, CI workflow and evaluation reports
checks: Open a pull request with a worse chunk size
Compare judge scores with human marks

days.topic: Observability and Feedback for RAG Systems
subtopics: Dashboards for quality, latency and cost
days.lab_task: Trace every query with retrieved chunks and scores, capture user feedback, build dashboards and use the worst-rated answers to find and fix two retrieval problems.
days.deliverable: Tracing setup, dashboards and two fixes with evidence
checks: Shows rewritten query, chunks, scores, prompt and answer
Rerun failed questions after the fixes

days.topic: Cost, Latency and Caching in RAG
days.lab_task: Reduce cost per query by at least 40 percent and p95 latency by 30 percent with semantic caching, model routing and batch embedding while keeping evaluation scores within two points.
days.deliverable: Optimisation report with cost, latency and quality

days.topic: Multilingual and Domain-Specific RAG
days.lab_task: Make the assistant answer questions in Hindi, Tamil and English over English documents, add a glossary for domain acronyms and measure accuracy per language.
days.deliverable: Multilingual pipeline and per-language results
checks: Answer in Hindi with English sources cited
Glossary expands it and retrieval succeeds

days.topic: Security, Permissions and Compliance in Enterprise RAG
subtopics: Syncing permissions from SharePoint or Google Drive
days.lab_task: Sync document permissions from a SharePoint test site into the index, block retrieval of documents above the user's classification and run a leakage test suite.
days.deliverable: Permission sync, classification filter and leakage test report
checks: Next sync removes their retrieval access
Ask for a summary that would include a restricted document

days.topic: Scaling RAG Services
days.lab_task: Scale the query service to 200 concurrent users and ingestion to 50,000 documents per hour on Kubernetes with queues, provider rate limits and a recovery test.
days.deliverable: Deployment files, load test results and recovery record
checks: p95 latency meets the target with no errors
Service recovers with no data loss

days.topic: Managed RAG Services on the Cloud
subtopics: Azure AI Search with integrated vectorisation
Quality compared with a custom pipeline
days.lab_task: Build the handbook assistant on one managed RAG service, compare its quality, effort and cost with the custom pipeline on the same test set and write a build-or-buy recommendation.
days.deliverable: Managed implementation, comparison and recommendation
checks: Run the test set on the managed service
Estimate monthly cost at the expected load
Cost compared with the custom pipeline
Supported by quality, effort and cost

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Enterprise Document Intelligence Platform
days.lab_task: Deliver a document intelligence platform over a large mixed collection with layout-aware ingestion, hybrid and routed retrieval with reranking, permission sync, CI evaluation, tracing and a scaled deployment, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, evaluation reports, dashboards, deployment and a 15-minute demo
checks: Meets the agreed recall and faithfulness targets
Ask as a user without access
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one platform

advanced.summary: For engineers and architects running RAG in production. Covers retrieval research methods, training retrievers and rerankers, advanced graph and agentic retrieval, evaluation science, RAG security, platform design for many teams, governance and the economics of retrieval systems.
prerequisites: Has run a RAG system in production
Comfortable with Python, cloud platforms and basic machine learning
outcomes: Train and tune retrievers and rerankers for a domain
Build advanced graph, agentic and structured retrieval
Architect, secure and govern RAG platforms for many teams

days.topic: Retrieval Theory and Failure Analysis
subtopics: Why retrieval fails: vocabulary, granularity, ambiguity
Turning failure analysis into a roadmap
days.lab_task: Classify 100 failed production questions into an error taxonomy, compute the upper bound for answer accuracy given perfect retrieval and write a prioritised improvement roadmap.
days.deliverable: Failure analysis, upper bound result and roadmap
checks: Every failure has a category and an example
Test answers with the correct chunks supplied
Items ordered by failures fixed per effort

days.topic: Training Retrievers: Contrastive Learning and Hard Negatives
subtopics: Training data from logs and feedback
Avoiding overfitting to the test set
days.lab_task: Train a domain retriever with hard negatives mined from production logs, compare it with the best stock model on a held-out set and plan the re-index of 5 million chunks.
days.deliverable: Training runs, evaluation and re-index plan
checks: Compare recall@10 on the held-out set
Trained retriever beats the stock model
Check for overlap between training and test questions
Time, cost and switch-over steps stated

days.topic: Training and Distilling Rerankers
subtopics: Distilling LLM judgements into small rerankers
Serving rerankers on CPU and GPU
days.lab_task: Distil an LLM reranker into a small cross-encoder, quantise it with ONNX and show it keeps most of the accuracy at a fraction of the latency.
days.deliverable: Distilled reranker, benchmark and evaluation
checks: Compare NDCG@10 with the LLM reranker
Compare model size before and after quantisation

days.topic: Late-Interaction and Multi-Vector Retrieval
days.lab_task: Index scanned manuals with ColPali and text with ColBERT, compare retrieval quality and storage with the dense baseline and decide where to use them.
days.deliverable: Two indexes, benchmark results and a recommendation
checks: ColPali result recorded against the baseline
Use cases chosen with the numbers

days.topic: Advanced GraphRAG and Knowledge Engineering
days.lab_task: Design an ontology for supplier risk, resolve duplicate entities, build a temporal graph from contracts and news, and answer time-based multi-hop questions with Cypher generated by an LLM.
days.deliverable: Ontology, graph, query pipeline and quality report
checks: Duplicate suppliers are merged with precision recorded
Ask "which suppliers had a sanctions issue after their 2024 renewal?"
Correct suppliers returned with graph paths

days.topic: Structured Retrieval: Text-to-SQL at Enterprise Scale
days.lab_task: Build a text-to-SQL system over a 200-table warehouse using a semantic layer and schema linking, validate SQL before running it and reach the agreed accuracy on 50 business questions.
days.deliverable: Text-to-SQL pipeline and evaluation results
checks: Generate SQL that would scan a huge table without a filter
Ask about a metric defined in the semantic layer

days.topic: Agentic and Deep Research Retrieval
days.lab_task: Build a research agent that plans sub-questions, searches internal and approved external sources, scores sources and writes a cited five-page report within a cost budget.
days.deliverable: Research agent, three reports and evaluation
checks: Check every citation in a report
Agent finishes with what it has and says what is missing

days.topic: Evaluation Science for Retrieval Systems
days.lab_task: Annotate 200 question-answer pairs with two reviewers, measure agreement, compare two pipelines with confidence intervals and report whether the improvement is real.
days.deliverable: Annotations, agreement score, statistical comparison and report
checks: Report says whether the difference is significant

days.topic: Adversarial Attacks and Security Testing of RAG
days.lab_task: Poison the index with planted documents, run injection and extraction attacks, add provenance checks and filters, and show the attacks failing on retest.
days.deliverable: Attack report, defences and retest results
checks: Add a poisoned document that targets a common question
Attack succeeds before and fails after the defences
Try to extract a restricted document

days.topic: RAG Platform Design for Many Teams
days.lab_task: Build a minimal RAG platform where two teams create their own collections through an API with isolated data, shared evaluation and cost reporting per team.
days.deliverable: Platform services, onboarding record and cost report
checks: Search one team's collection as the other team
Create a collection through the API
Ready for ingestion with no manual steps

days.topic: Governance, Provenance and Regulatory Compliance
subtopics: Data lineage from source to answer
days.lab_task: Record lineage from every source document to every answer, prepare an audit pack for one month of answers and carry out an erasure request across all indexes and caches.
days.deliverable: Lineage records, audit pack and erasure record
checks: Its source documents and versions are traceable
Data removed from indexes, caches and logs

days.topic: Real-Time and Streaming RAG
days.lab_task: Stream support tickets from a database through Kafka into the index with change data capture, keep freshness under one minute and answer time-aware questions.
days.deliverable: Streaming pipeline, freshness metrics and test answers
checks: Ask "what was raised in the last hour?"
Stop the consumer for five minutes then restart

days.topic: Edge, On-Premises and Air-Gapped RAG
days.lab_task: Build an air-gapped RAG system with local models and storage, show it works with all outbound traffic blocked, and compare quality and cost with the cloud version.
days.deliverable: Offline deployment, network test and comparison report
checks: Compare accuracy with the cloud version

days.topic: Personalisation and Recommendation with Retrieval
days.lab_task: Personalise the knowledge assistant by role and past questions, measure the gain on role-specific test sets and confirm users can turn personalisation off.
days.deliverable: Personalisation code and evaluation results
checks: Compare accuracy for three roles with and without personalisation

days.topic: Fine-Tuning Generators for Grounded Answers
subtopics: When prompting is not enough for faithfulness
Training data from good grounded answers
Teaching the model to refuse without evidence
days.lab_task: Fine-tune a small open model on grounded answers with distractor chunks, compare faithfulness, refusals and citation accuracy with the prompted base model and work out the serving cost.
days.deliverable: Training data, fine-tuned model, evaluation and cost note
checks: Compare faithfulness on the test set
Ask questions with only distractor chunks
Fine-tuned model refuses more often than the base model

days.topic: Economics and Capacity Planning for RAG
days.lab_task: Build a three-year cost and capacity model for the document platform at three growth rates, compare custom and managed options and present a recommendation.
days.deliverable: Cost and capacity model and a five-slide recommendation
checks: Model updates storage, compute and cost

days.topic: Production Incident Response for RAG Systems
days.lab_task: Handle three injected incidents (a bad re-index, a permission sync failure and a vector database outage), restore service, find root causes and write runbooks.
days.deliverable: Incident timelines, fixes and runbooks
checks: No user sees documents they should not
Write a runbook for a vector database outage

days.topic: Emerging Retrieval Methods and Research Review
days.lab_task: Pick a recent retrieval paper, reproduce its main result on your test set, compare it with your production pipeline and write an adopt or reject note.
days.deliverable: Reproduction code, results and adoption note
checks: Runs on your data with results recorded
Difference measured on the same test set

days.topic: Retrieval Architecture Reviews and Strategy
days.lab_task: Review two proposed RAG designs from a case study, find their main risks, write decision records and defend a recommendation to a mock architecture board.
days.deliverable: Review notes, decision records and presentation
checks: List the risks in each design

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Governed Retrieval Platform for the Enterprise
subtopics: Streaming freshness, scale and cost model
days.lab_task: Deliver a multi-team retrieval platform with trained retrievers and rerankers, graph and SQL retrieval, a research agent, streaming freshness, lineage, red-team results and a cost model, then present it to a mock board.
days.deliverable: Platform repository, evaluation and security reports, cost model and a 20-minute presentation
checks: Compare the platform with the intermediate capstone on the same test set
Trace a random answer to its sources
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
